text.O acesso ao site é sempre cifrado. As se: Access to the site is always encrypted. Passwords are stored as hashes. The database isolates data per person at the database level, not just on screen — even if someone bypasses the interface, they can't reach anyone else's conversations. Model provider keys live only on the server and are never sent to the browser. No system is perfect: if we discover an incident that could put you at risk, we notify you and the ANPD.
